# Swing Cool Kidz

> Swing Cool Kidz is a swing dance community in Đà Nẵng and Hội An, Vietnam (founded 2016). We dance Lindy Hop, Vernacular Solo Jazz, Balboa, Blues and Shag, and run beginner-friendly socials about every other week.

## Socials
- **Social + Taster Class at Blends** — Blends Social Bar, Đà Nẵng. Every other Thursday, 7–9PM, with a 45-minute beginner taster class. Entry 70,000 VND incl. one drink (Huda or water). Friends / non-dancers welcome (same ticket).
- **Live Jazz Social at Hyatt Terrasse** — Terrasse Bar, Hyatt Regency Đà Nẵng. Every other Wednesday, 8–10PM, live music with the HAT Jazz Band on a wooden floor. No entrance fee — buy a drink or food from the menu. Reserve/attendance via the WhatsApp poll (closes 3PM Wednesday).
- The two venues alternate week to week, so there is a social most weeks.

## Who it's for
All levels welcome; no partner and no experience needed. Shoes: sneakers are fine — no high heels or open-toed sandals.

## Community
- Saigon Swing Cats (Ho Chi Minh City) — weekly socials.
- Swing Dancing Hanoi (Hà Nội) — weekly socials.
- Big events: Hanoi Lindy Weekend (20–22 Nov 2026), Vietnam Lindy Exchange / VLX (Hội An, 19–21 Mar 2027).
